header.title: API keys
header.description: Manage integration keys with granular scopes, rate limits and IP allowlists.

list.empty: No API keys yet. Create one to start integrating.
list.noScopes: No scopes — this key can't do anything

createDialog.title: New API key — step {{step}} of 3
createDialog.step1Description: Give your key a name and description.
createDialog.step2Description: Choose exactly which actions this key may perform.
createDialog.step3Description: Set optional restrictions (rate limit, IP, expiry).
createDialog.descriptionPlaceholder: What will you use this key for?
createDialog.rateLimitHint: Default 100 req/min. Increase when running large-scale bulk imports.
createDialog.ipHint: Comma-separated list. Leave empty = no IP restriction.

createdDialog.title: Key created
createdDialog.description: {{name}} — copy the key now, you won't see it again.
createdDialog.warning: Store this key securely (in a password manager, not in git). If lost, you can rotate the key — the old one becomes invalid immediately.

rotatedDialog.title: Key rotated
rotatedDialog.description: The old key became invalid immediately. Update your integration.
rotatedDialog.warning: You'll see this new key only once. Copy it now.

confirmRotate.title: Rotate key?
confirmRotate.description: The current key becomes invalid immediately. Integrations using the old key will get 401 errors until you update them.

confirmRevoke.title: Revoke key?
confirmRevoke.description: This action is permanent — the key stops working immediately and cannot be restored.
